Implementation Summary

Implemented the reader detail endpoint for marketing blog articles. Fetches published articles by unique slug, increments views_count in a background goroutine, returns the Editor.js content payload, author profile, and dynamically populates up to 4 related articles from the same category or latest posts.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/getPublicArticle.go)

func GetPublicArticle(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	slug := c.Params("slug")
	if slug == "" {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusBadRequest, Messages: "Article slug is required"})
	}

	var article models.BlogArticle
	err := config.DB.Preload("Author").Preload("Category").
		Where("slug = ? AND status = ?", slug, "published").
		First(&article).Error

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusNotFound, Messages: "Article not found"})
		}
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusInternalServerError, Messages: "Database error: " + err.Error()})
	}

	// Asynchronous view count increment
	go func(id string) {
		config.DB.Model(&models.BlogArticle{}).
			Where("id = ?", id).
			UpdateColumn("views_count", gorm.Expr("views_count + 1"))
	}(article.ID.String())

	// Fetch up to 4 related articles
	var relatedRaw []models.BlogArticle
	relatedQuery := config.DB.Model(&models.BlogArticle{}).
		Where("status = ? AND id != ?", "published", article.ID)
	if article.CategoryID != nil {
		relatedQuery = relatedQuery.Where("category_id = ?", article.CategoryID)
	}
	_ = relatedQuery.Order("published_at DESC").Limit(4).Find(&relatedRaw).Error

	// Response formatting...
}

Behavior

  • Only published articles can be retrieved. Draft articles return 404 Not Found.
  • View counter increases non-blockingly without delaying response time.
  • Returns rich Editor.js document blocks in raw JSON so frontends can render natively using @editorjs/editorjs tools or HTML converters.

Implementation Summary

Implemented the static media serving endpoint for blog assets. Allows public image loading for hero cover images and inline Editor.js figures while enforcing directory isolation and path traversal guards.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/supportUploadImage.go)

func GetBlogAsset(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	fileName := filepath.Clean(c.Params("file_name"))
	if strings.Contains(fileName, "..") {
		return c.SendStatus(fiber.StatusBadRequest)
	}

	baseDir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DIRECTORY_IMAGES"))
	if baseDir == "" {
		baseDir = strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DIRECTORY_ASSET"))
	}
	if baseDir == "" {
		baseDir = "uploads"
	}

	filePath := filepath.Join(baseDir, "blog", fileName)
	if _, err := os.Stat(filePath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return c.SendStatus(fiber.StatusNotFound)
	}

	return c.SendFile(filePath)
}

Security Guards

  • Uses filepath.Clean and checks for .. sequences to prevent directory traversal outside the blog upload folder.
  • Uses Fiber's SendFile to automatically infer and set the appropriate MIME type header (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, etc.).

Implementation Summary

Implemented the public article retrieval endpoint for the marketing blog. Supports server-side pagination (with limit capping), search against title/excerpt/keywords, filtering by category (via slug or UUID), filtering by tag, and filtering by featured status.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/listPublicArticles.go)

func ListPublicArticles(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	page, limit, offset := ParsePagination(c.Query("page"), c.Query("limit"), 10, 50)
	search := strings.TrimSpace(c.Query("search"))
	categoryQuery := strings.TrimSpace(c.Query("category"))
	tagQuery := strings.TrimSpace(c.Query("tag"))
	featuredQuery := strings.TrimSpace(c.Query("featured"))

	query := config.DB.Model(&models.BlogArticle{}).
		Preload("Author").
		Preload("Category").
		Where("status = ?", "published")

	if search != "" {
		searchLike := "%" + search + "%"
		query = query.Where("(title ILIKE ? OR excerpt ILIKE ? OR seo_keywords ILIKE ?)", searchLike, searchLike, searchLike)
	}

	if categoryQuery != "" {
		if catID, err := uuid.Parse(categoryQuery); err == nil {
			query = query.Where("category_id = ?", catID)
		} else {
			var cat models.BlogCategory
			if err := config.DB.Select("id").Where("slug = ?", categoryQuery).First(&cat).Error; err == nil {
				query = query.Where("category_id = ?", cat.ID)
			} else {
				return helpers.SendSuccess(c, helpers.SuccessOpts{
					Status:   fiber.StatusOK,
					Messages: "Public articles list",
					Data: fiber.Map{
						"articles":    []publicArticleListItem{},
						"total":       0,
						"page":        page,
						"limit":       limit,
						"total_pages": 0,
					},
				})
			}
		}
	}

	if tagQuery != "" {
		query = query.Where("tags::text ILIKE ?", "%\""+tagQuery+"\"%")
	}

	if strings.EqualFold(featuredQuery, "true") || featuredQuery == "1" {
		query = query.Where("is_featured = ?", true)
	}

	var total int64
	_ = query.Count(&total)

	var articles []models.BlogArticle
	if total > 0 {
		_ = query.Order("is_featured DESC, published_at DESC, created_at DESC").
			Limit(limit).Offset(offset).Find(&articles)
	}
	// Items mapping and return envelope
}

Implementation Summary

Implemented the public category listing endpoint. Retrieves all categories ordered alphabetically by name and enriches each category with an articles_count field counting only articles with status = 'published'.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/listPublicCategories.go)

func ListPublicCategories(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	var categories []models.BlogCategory
	if err := config.DB.Order("name ASC").Find(&categories).Error; err != nil {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusInternalServerError, Messages: "Failed to fetch categories: " + err.Error()})
	}

	type catCount struct {
		CategoryID string `gorm:"column:category_id"`
		Total      int64  `gorm:"column:total"`
	}
	var counts []catCount
	config.DB.Model(&models.BlogArticle{}).
		Select("category_id, count(*) as total").
		Where("status = ?", "published").
		Group("category_id").
		Scan(&counts)

	countMap := make(map[string]int64)
	for _, cc := range counts {
		countMap[cc.CategoryID] = cc.Total
	}

	result := make([]publicCategoryItem, 0, len(categories))
	for _, cat := range categories {
		desc := ""
		if cat.Description != nil {
			desc = *cat.Description
		}
		result = append(result, publicCategoryItem{
			ID:            cat.ID.String(),
			Name:          cat.Name,
			Slug:          cat.Slug,
			Description:   desc,
			ArticlesCount: countMap[cat.ID.String()],
		})
	}
	// Return success response...
}

Behavior

  • Runs a fast grouped query to calculate the number of published articles per category.
  • Categories with 0 articles are still returned so visitors can see the available taxonomies.

Implementation Summary

Implemented the public tag aggregation endpoint. Plucks all tags JSONB values from published articles, unpacks them into Go slices, and deduplicates them into a clean array of unique tag strings for the client tag cloud.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/listPublicTags.go)

func ListPublicTags(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	var rawTagsList []json.RawMessage

	if err := config.DB.Model(&models.BlogArticle{}).
		Where("status = ?", "published").
		Pluck("tags", &rawTagsList).Error; err != nil {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{
			Status:   fiber.StatusInternalServerError,
			Messages: "Failed to fetch tags: " + err.Error(),
		})
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	tags := make([]string, 0)

	for _, raw := range rawTagsList {
		var itemTags []string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &itemTags); err == nil {
			for _, tag := range itemTags {
				if tag == "" {
					continue
				}
				if _, exists := seen[tag]; !exists {
					seen[tag] = struct{}{}
					tags = append(tags, tag)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return helpers.SendSuccess(c, helpers.SuccessOpts{
		Status:   fiber.StatusOK,
		Messages: "Public tags list",
		Data:     fiber.Map{"tags": tags},
	})
}

Behavior

  • Only processes tags from published articles.
  • Eliminates duplicate entries and empty string tags.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/supportCreateArticle.go)

func SupportCreateArticle(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	supportUser, ok := c.Locals("support_user").(*models.User)
	if !ok || supportUser == nil {
		user, err := helpers.GetAuthUser(c)
		if err != nil {
			return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusUnauthorized, Messages: "Unauthorized"})
		}
		supportUser = user
	}

	var req createArticleRequest
	if err := c.BodyParser(&req); err != nil {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusBadRequest, Messages: "Invalid JSON request body"})
	}

	title := strings.TrimSpace(req.Title)
	if title == "" {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusBadRequest, Messages: "Title is required"})
	}

	// Slug generation & collision resolution
	slug := Slugify(title)
	var existing models.BlogArticle
	if err := config.DB.Where("slug = ?", slug).First(&existing).Error; err == nil {
		slug = slug + "-" + uuid.New().String()[:6]
	}

	// Tags normalization
	normalizedTags := NormalizeTags(req.Tags)
	tagsJSON, _ := json.Marshal(normalizedTags)

	// Article persistence
	article := models.BlogArticle{
		AuthorID:       supportUser.ID,
		CategoryID:     categoryID,
		Title:          title,
		Slug:           slug,
		Excerpt:        req.Excerpt,
		Content:        content,
		CoverImage:     req.CoverImage,
		Tags:           tagsJSON,
		Status:         status,
		IsFeatured:     isFeatured,
		SEOTitle:       req.SEOTitle,
		SEODescription: req.SEODescription,
		SEOKeywords:    req.SEOKeywords,
		PublishedAt:    publishedAt,
	}

	if err := config.DB.Create(&article).Error; err != nil {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusInternalServerError, Messages: "Failed to create article: " + err.Error()})
	}
	// Return 201 Created...
}

Implementation Summary

Implemented the image upload endpoint for @editorjs/editorjs Image Tool and article cover photos. Accepts multipart form data, validates file extensions and sizes, generates collision-free file names, and returns a response schema directly compliant with the Editor.js image tool.

Key Code Logic (src/action/v1/blog/supportUploadImage.go)

func SupportUploadImage(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	fileHeader, fileErr := c.FormFile("image")
	if fileErr != nil || fileHeader == nil {
		fileHeader, fileErr = c.FormFile("file")
		if fileErr != nil || fileHeader == nil {
			return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{
				Status:   fiber.StatusBadRequest,
				Messages: "Image file is required (form field: 'image' or 'file')",
			})
		}
	}

	ext := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(fileHeader.Filename), "."))
	if ext != "jpg" && ext != "jpeg" && ext != "png" && ext != "webp" && ext != "gif" {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{
			Status:   fiber.StatusBadRequest,
			Messages: "Image extension not allowed. Supported: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif",
		})
	}

	if fileHeader.Size > 10*1024*1024 {
		return helpers.SendError(c, helpers.ErrorOpts{Status: fiber.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, Messages: "Image too large, maximum size is 10MB"})
	}

	baseDir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DIRECTORY_IMAGES"))
	if baseDir == "" {
		baseDir = strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DIRECTORY_ASSET"))
	}
	if baseDir == "" {
		baseDir = "uploads"
	}

	blogDir := filepath.Join(baseDir, "blog")
	_ = os.MkdirAll(blogDir, 0o755)

	filename, _ := helpers.RandomHexFilename(ext)
	dst := filepath.Join(blogDir, filename)
	_ = c.SaveFile(fileHeader, dst)

	appURL := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("APP_URL"), "/")
	var imageURL string
	if appURL != "" {
		imageURL = fmt.Sprintf("%s/v1/asset/blog/%s", appURL, filename)
	} else {
		imageURL = fmt.Sprintf("/v1/asset/blog/%s", filename)
	}

	// Editor.js Image Tool response contract
	return c.Status(fiber.StatusOK).JSON(fiber.Map{
		"success": 1,
		"file": fiber.Map{
			"url": imageURL,
		},
		"data": fiber.Map{
			"url":      imageURL,
			"filename": filename,
		},
		"messages": "Image uploaded successfully",
	})
}

Behavior

  • Accepts both image (Editor.js default) and file form-data keys.
  • Directly satisfies Editor.js Image Tool payload expectations without requiring frontend response transformation.
